note: Category:Quest monsters / Category:Quest NPCs membership is the default signal for 'this account can only get one roll against this source, ever' (repeatable: false). It over-fires for a quest that merely GATES access to an otherwise ordinary, persistent boss, rather than being the boss's only encounter. Each entry here is a hand-verified exception, citing the wiki's own words, checked against the page's own wikitext rather than assumed. See apps/ingest/src/inventory/build.ts's deriveRepeatable and docs/DECISIONS.md.

entries.reason: Tagged Category:Quest monsters (first fought during Dragon Slayer II), but the page states outright: 'After completing Dragon Slayer II, players may fight Vorkath again, with increased stats and rewards.' The infobox itself carries a 'Post-quest' version distinct from the 'Dragon Slayer II' one, and Vorkath is one of the most heavily farmed bosses in the game. The quest gates access; it does not consume the encounter.

Tagged Category:Quest monsters (two are fought during Monkey Madness II, in the penultimate stage), but the page states: 'After the quest is completed, more demonic gorillas can be found in the caverns alongside their tortured counterparts,' and documents a per-account kill-count tracker (Nieve's gravestone). The quest gates access to the Crash Site Cavern; it does not consume the encounter, and demonic gorillas are heavily farmed post-quest for ballista pieces and zenyte shards.
